note: Site understanding settings (S6). No MUTCD value lives here. Every entry has a source or is tagged CALIBRATION_PENDING.

evidence_max_words.source: S0 prompt tuning proposal P1, approved S6 Q3 B

safety_critical_fields.source: owner decision, S6 session 1 (Q7/Q8): AI plus OSM must agree, otherwise UNKNOWN

ai_only_review_fields.note: AI-only registry facts with no second source: a value that reaches a rule input carries AI_ONLY_UNCONFIRMED (REVIEW_REQUIRED, naming the fact). No new floor number.

edge_pixel_error_px_cross_section.note: D-38 example: one pixel of error on each edge. Starting value for the deterministic cross-section. S6 STOP 2: accepted as the starting model.

edge_pixel_error_px_ai_marks.note: Derived from the nine recorded spike widths (claude-opus-5-5, pre-tuning prompt, 3 sites x 3 repetitions): at the spike scale (about 0.44 m per pixel) all nine traveled-way widths fall inside the band (3.0 px x 2 edges) around their site's median, which 1.0 px and 2.0 px do not achieve. NOT calibrated against drawings (Q20). gpt-5.6-sol has not run; its marks may differ. Recorded as a test (test_ai_mark_error_evidence).

edges_per_width.source: geometry: a width is bounded by two edges, each with the pixel error

interval_includes_section_spread.source: S6 Q9 A: interval = width +/- (edge error x mpp_sent x edges) plus the section spread

work_vehicle_width_in.source: 23 CFR 658.15 (maximum vehicle width 102 in); owner decision S6 session 1
work_vehicle_width_in.note: Used only when no vehicle is measured in the image. Optional: a caller may leave it out of the footprint.

work_space_depth_ft.note: No source. Asked per job (asked-if-needed work_type and size, S11); stays UNKNOWN until the SME supplies it.

work_space_clearance_ft.note: Clearance between the work space and the near face of the devices. No source. Asked per job.

crops.note: Crop engine (S6 commit 5, Q15 A). The crop centre is always the work reference (the image centre), computed by code; the model never chooses a crop. Values for the lane features are READ from config/pipeline_config.json (crops.min_px_per_lane, fusion.lane_width_plausible_m, crops.primary_zoom, crops.image_px, sharpness.uniform_max_std), not copied here.

lane_group.source: S6 Q15 A: the existing crops.min_px_per_lane applies to the lane features
lane_group.feature_m: the low end of fusion.lane_width_plausible_m (the narrowest plausible lane: the conservative case)

pending_features.note: No pixels-per-feature value exists for these. Until one is calibrated they are never judged sufficient, so a higher-zoom view (up to the zoom ceiling) is always requested when one of them is needed. May cost extra Azure Maps requests.

zoom_ceiling.source: config/pipeline_config.json crops.primary_zoom (the documented maximum of the microsoft.imagery tileset); no higher zoom is ever requested, so the upsampling sharpness check (sharpness.min_detail_gain_ratio) is not needed here

osm.note: OSM rules of S6 (owner plan 2026-10-31). Every distance and angle is CALIBRATION_PENDING: a starting value that is used and flagged, not a calibrated one. A missing lanes or shoulder tag is no information; a missing oneway tag counts as not one-way at lower confidence.

query_radius_m.note: radius of the one bounded Overpass query around the work point; must not exceed config/data_sources.json osm_overpass.query_limits.max_radius_m

highway_classes.source: OSM wiki Key:highway (road classes a vehicle can use); service included for driveways and parking aisles so they can be told apart, never chosen over a named road

max_way_distance_m.note: a way farther than this from the work point is not the road of the job

divided_max_separation_m.note: largest distance between the two carriageways of a divided road

divided_parallel_tolerance_deg.note: largest angle (mod 180) between the two ways for them to count as parallel

divided_require_same_name_or_ref.note: the opposite way must share the name or the ref of the chosen way

bearing.note: Bearing cross-check (owner plan 2026-10-31). The road direction read from the AI's edge and lane-line marks (code, modulo 180) must match the nearest OSM way within the tolerance. Evidence: the nine gpt-5.6-sol calls gave E Second St 0, 90, 91 degrees and Colorado 28, 140, 41 degrees; the Claude calls 90,90,90 and 36,39,39.

tolerance_deg.note: largest angle (mod 180) between the mark bearing and an OSM way bearing for them to be the same road

which_road_distance_m.note: OSM ways (service ways excluded) within this distance of the work point are the candidates for the reference road; the nearest is used only when it is clearly nearer than the next road that runs a different way (nearest_margin_m)

nearest_margin_m.note: the OSM reference way is the one nearest the work point only if it is at least this much nearer than the next road that runs a different way; otherwise the SME is asked which road. The marks never choose the reference way.

edge_rule.note: Work-location edge rule (owner plan 2026-10-31). The AI's own work_location reading is not trusted close to a road edge: a mark or a pixel is only a few metres wide.

near_edge_m.note: within this distance of the nearest road edge (or with no road near) work_location is UNKNOWN plus one SME question

no_road_near_m.note: no road near: no OSM way within this distance of the work point and no usable road-edge marks. With a road within the distance a BEYOND_SHOULDER answer stays FOUND; with none the SME gets one question candidate (informational unless S7's what-if test makes it blocking)

confidence_floors.note: Confidence floors (owner plan 2026-10-31): a default entry plus optional per-profile entries, looked up by the Foundry profile name (for example gpt-5.6-sol). A model reports confidence on its own scale, so one profile may need a different floor; nothing is entered for a profile until it is calibrated. A floor of null applies none. Kinds: work_location, safety_critical (lanes_per_direction, divided_highway, shoulder_present, oneway: the AI plus OSM must still agree), common (every other fact).

snapping.note: Code snapping of the AI's marks to the nearest real edge in the image (S6 step 8). The AI draws roughly; code decides where the edge is. All values CALIBRATION_PENDING.

features.note: marks that follow a step edge; lane lines are painted stripes and are not snapped

search_radius_px.note: how far from the AI's point, across the line, an edge is searched (pixels of the image as sent)

sample_step_px.note: spacing of the sample points along the AI's polyline

min_edge_contrast.note: smallest grey-level step (0 to 255) across a candidate edge for it to count as a real edge

min_accepted_fraction.note: a mark with a smaller share of sample points that found an edge is rejected (no_edge_nearby)

smooth_window.note: odd number of sample points of the median filter over the offsets along the line

code_checks.note: Code checks on the image (S6 step 9). Each returns evidence and can only lower confidence or give UNKNOWN; none is ever a second source. All values CALIBRATION_PENDING.

stations.note: cross-sections taken along the road strip between the two edge marks

lane_line_min_contrast.note: grey-level excess of a painted line over the local pavement (0 to 255)

lane_line_max_width_px.note: widest bright run that still counts as a painted line (pixels of the image as sent)

lane_line_merge_px.note: two lines closer than this (a double yellow) count as one

lane_line_edge_margin_px.note: lines this close to an edge mark are edge lines, not lane lines

lane_line_min_station_fraction.note: a line must be seen in this share of the stations to count as detected

lane_line_position_tolerance_px.note: lateral position tolerance when matching a line between stations

min_lines_to_judge.note: with fewer painted lines than this detected the lane-line check does nothing (owner review R5: it never lowers confidence when no painted lines are detected)

green_margin.note: a pixel is canopy when its green exceeds both red and blue by this much

shadow_luminance_ratio.note: a non-canopy pixel is shadow when darker than this share of the strip's reference luminance

reference_percentile.note: percentile of the non-canopy strip luminance used as the sunlit reference

occlusion_share_max.note: code share of the road strip hidden by shadow plus canopy above which edge-based facts become UNKNOWN (occluded)

model_share_tolerance.note: the model's shadow and canopy shares are a cross-check candidate: a difference above this is recorded as evidence; it never changes a fact

max_osm_offset_m.note: largest distance between the road centre seen in the marks and the OSM reference way; above it OSM cannot confirm an AI value

consistency.note: Consistency checks between facts (S6 step 9). Config driven; each can only lower trust (UNKNOWN or a flag). Values CALIBRATION_PENDING.

lane_count_vs_width.note: runs ONLY when parking_present and shoulder_present are both read false (owner review R5); plausible lane width range is read from pipeline_config fusion.lane_width_plausible_m

lane_lines_vs_lane_count.note: painted lane lines against the lane count; nothing happens when no painted line is detected (R5)

work_location_vs_edges.note: work_location against the work point and the edge marks (the marks check)

stages.note: Per-stage off switches (S6 step 10): turn a stage off to see in a scored test what it adds. enhanced_prompt false means prompt version 1 (the nine recorded calls); true means version 2 (STOP 6). A stage that is off is recorded in the run trace.

osm.note: read OSM and compare it with the AI (two-source rule). Off: every safety field has a single source

snapping.note: code snapping of the AI's marks to the nearest real edge

edge_rule.note: work location near an edge or with no road near

shadow_canopy.note: code check: shadow and canopy share

osm_offset.note: code check: image to OSM offset

enhanced_prompt.note: prompt version 2; off until the owner has run the version 2 live calls and decided
